facts.statement: The study investigated how specific cognitive test scores relate to white matter health in people with Huntington's disease.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: Researchers used a type of brain scan called Diffusion Tensor Imaging to measure white matter properties in 22 people with early-stage Huntington's disease and 20 healthy controls.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: A statistical method was applied to compare the two groups and link the brain scan measurements to the patients' performance on different parts of the cognitive test.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: Of all the cognitive areas tested, only visuospatial ability was linked to the condition of white matter in three specific brain regions.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The results suggest that combining brain scans with a short cognitive screening tool can help identify specific brain areas related to certain cognitive skills in early-stage patients.
facts.subject: humans
